name: Old Growth
blurb: A logger the size of a stump, in red flannel and caulk boots, on a bike that smells of bar oil. Says about one sentence a mile.

meta.notes: Pacific Northwest local (region-pnw, playtest 1c). A heavy hitter: slow, heavy, hard to knock down, holds his line and leans on whoever is nearest. Signature line (agent draft, not yet maintainer-approved): "These trees were here before you. So was I."
